Header banner for /collections/serums.

SOURCE resolved from the contact sheet, and checked for a -v2- sibling first. Only one file on disk carries this shot id, and there is no superseded acetyl wave, so it is unambiguous: acetyl-hexapeptide-8-serum--A-face-full-prod-left-nbp_flash_01, 6336x2688 (2.357:1), scaled to a 1999x848 working frame and extended LEFT to 3750x848 (4.42:1).

THE LABEL IS THE REASON THIS FRAME IS WORTH PUBLISHING. Checked at 100%: all six elements present, correctly spelled and cleanly drawn - the helix as dots and dashes, 'Skingenetix' with a capital S, 'ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8' with the hyphen before the digit, 'ANTI-WRINKLE SERUM' with a real W, 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and '10% ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8 | 30ML'. That is reference quality, and it is rare on this product: the same day, the fine-lines banner shipped with its last two lines missing entirely and SERUMS-R2-A seedream_01 mangled five of six.

THE SWAP FLIPS THE BANNER. The previous frame extended RIGHT. This one cannot: its right edge is her neck and shoulder at mean luminance 160, minimum 115 - lit skin top to bottom, nothing to sample. The left edge measures 21.3 to 26.4 with nothing above 45 anywhere down it. So the canvas grows left, the heading moves left with it, and object-position flips from left center to right center.

TEXTURE IS SCATTERED, NOT TILED, AND THE MAX-LUMINANCE CHECK DID NOT CATCH WHY. The sample box reads max 30 against a backdrop of 24 - clean by every threshold test - but it carries a faint vertical structure, and mirror-tiling it across 1751px printed seven evenly spaced dark lens shapes down the middle of the extension. Caught by looking, not by measuring. Scatter has no tile boundaries to line up. Residual row banding: 2.31 levels on a background of 23.

Heading ground after extension: 336px at 1280, 496px at 1440, 975px at 1920 - roomier than any other banner published this week, so no desktop scrim is needed here.
